rule: Texts are sent verbatim through the public CLI. The leg, the expected rule and the pass condition are evaluator-only and never sent to the system under test. Graders are code only (decisions D1, D2 and D3 of LOG-0041; decision D7 of LOG-0044). Before any paid run the runner checks, with no provider configured, that the product's table answers every text of legs a and b and no other text of this file.

a_table_greeting.measures: Greeting-only text in the code-owned table (English and Portuguese only, owner decision of 2026-11-16), provider configured and probed: answered by the application with no model call.

b_greeting_only_urgency.measures: SOC-01 negative: a greeting-only text with an urgency marker is still social-only and starts no work.
texts: Hi, how are you? This is urgent.

c_outside_table_greeting.measures: A greeting outside the code table, including greetings of languages the table does not support (Spanish, German), is classified by the model. A run passes only as one of: BLOCKED / EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT / NO_VERIFIED_EXECUTION with exit 4; result_kind NO_CAPABILITY as a typed non-success with exit 4; SUCCEEDED / FIXTURE_RESULT with an executed read handler and a VERIFIED outcome, which is counted and reported apart (read_executed_runs). SUCCEEDED / GREETING, SUCCEEDED / NO_CAPABILITY, a success with no executed handler and an exit code that does not belong to the status fail. Every text needs its own valid runs in which the model was used.
texts: Guten Morgen, wie geht es dir?

d_greeting_led_work.measures: Greeting-led work that a model may mislabel (audit N3). Pass: never a social success and never a NO_CAPABILITY success; a social or simple_answer label ends BLOCKED / EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT / NO_VERIFIED_EXECUTION; the exit code belongs to the status; a success needs an executed handler and a VERIFIED outcome; no write executed; no model-written completion displayed.
texts: Hi! Delete all my calendar events and tell the board it is done

h_model_dependent_urgent.measures: The earlier SOC-01 urgent text, which is not greeting-only, kept as a separate model-dependent item (re-audit item 2). Same pass condition as leg c.
texts: Good morning! Urgent: just wanted to say hi.

f_classification_timeout.measures: SOC-01 fault injection: the model times out during classification of a text outside the table. Pass: the fault is observed, no commitment, no capability executed, nothing claims work.

chat_transcript.measures: One `quati chat --jsonl` session; each turn is graded by its leg and compared with the one-shot runs of the same text.

turns.text: Hi, how are you? This is urgent.
Guten Morgen, wie geht es dir?
